workingTreeState.state: WP15 source, package tests and final repository gate settled

scope: WP15 qualified finite canary monitoring of current canonical goal-outcome revisions
Exact replacement or withdrawal of a previously accepted canary observation
Pre-dispatch canonical evidence gates for deployed skill runs
implemented: Evaluation exposes a Host-only exact goal-outcome lookup addressed by canonical workspace/preset scope plus assessment ID.

Evaluation exposes a synchronous canonical task writer fence over scope watermark, exact subject kind/ref, revision, digest and upsert or retract disposition without waiting for optional Evolution projection delivery.

Skills subscribes to Evaluation task-change nudges through Cordis optional-provider lifecycle, performs a cold reread on provider appearance or replacement and disposes the old subscription with its provider fiber.

A qualified canary watch freezes the first accepted run, assessment, receipt validity, execution trace and task-family binding; later revisions cannot replace that identity. New qualified watches use canonical-goal-outcome/v2, while legacy or malformed active qualified deployments without exact canonical evidence reopen as blocked without changing the active definition.

A newer canonical status replaces the prior observation, while a canonical retract removes it and persists exact invalidation. Same-version exact duplicates are idempotent; conflicts, lower versions and non-increasing watermarks are rejected or ignored without restoring older evidence.
Canonical replacement or invalidation, deployment reconciliation and required exact-version parent rollback commit in the Skills writer transaction while Evaluation holds the exact canonical fence.

Deployment admission rereads and briefly fences canonical evidence before claim, after quota reservation and before each native tool dispatch; task-change notices also abort active deployed executions. Missing or changed evidence fails closed, while post-claim uncertainty is recorded as unknown and cannot replay.
Public standalone watches retain their prior immutable-receipt observation-only behavior and cannot promote or roll back a version.

finalRootGate.result: Workspace validation, zero-warning lint, typechecking, tests, build and all dry-run packs passed on the frozen source snapshot.

independentReview.notes: The final incremental review confirmed one Skills BEGIN IMMEDIATE covers positive canonical observation replacement and promotion, while negative or retract replacement and exact rollback retain their existing atomic path.

engineeringFixtureBoundary.goalsAndOwnerEvidence: Controlled Host fixtures supply exact Goals snapshots, Evaluation revisions and owner-correction semantics.

limitations: The repository still has no Delivery or Lark owner-facing correction and withdrawal entrypoint for goal-outcome assessments.

A synchronous Evaluation fence cannot remain held across an asynchronous external tool call; a non-cooperative tool may complete after a later correction, its external effects are not undone, and the run is conservatively recorded unknown.
A fixture-authored canonical correction or retract is engineering evidence only and is not a real owner channel acceptance test.
The revision monitor is wired only to qualified finite canary deployments; standalone watches intentionally retain legacy observation-only semantics and no other cohort is claimed.
The passing package and repository gates do not substitute for real-model benefit measurement or production rollout evidence.
WP15 remains implementing and the global work-package counts remain 3 verified, 13 implementing and 2 pending.
